'''Yuma''' (Japanese: '''ユマ''' ''Yuma'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG167|What I Did for Love!]]''. She is a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} and a former [[Pokémon Coordinator]].

Yuma approached {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} after noticing that [[Brock's Bonsly]] could only be raised by a talented Breeder. She complimented {{an|Brock}} on the {{pkmn|food}} he gives {{cat|Brock's Pokémon|his Pokémon}} and asked if he competes in [[Pokémon Contest]]s. Yuma revealed that she is a former winner of the [[Grand Festival]] and said that after she became a [[Top Coordinator]], she decided to pass on her skills to beginning Coordinators.

After being introduced to Brock's other Pokémon, Yuma suggested entering the [[Gardenia Town]] Pokémon Contest. Infatuated by her, Brock ran to the [[Contest Hall]] and got himself a [[Contest Pass]]. At the end of the [[Appeal|first round]], Yuma asked Brock if he would like to become her apprentice. However, upon seeing the [[Contest Battle|Battle Round]], she realized that Brock was already good enough and decided to take {{OBP|Mollie|AG167}} under her wing.

She does not appear to be bothered about Brock's feelings towards her and just laughs at his consistency when he flirts with [[Nurse Joy]] in the middle of his appeal.
